responsibility: Defines the generic GCC configuration for targets using GNU-style user space and glibc-like runtime conventions. It supplies startup/endfile specs around crtbegin/crtend and optional offloading/vtable verification objects, C++ predefined-macro policy, pthread and libc library specs, link sequencing for libgcc versus libc, libc capability hooks, sanitizer early-link specs, POSIX I/O support, and Fortran preinclude handling. This is the main reusable userspace-spec layer for GNU/glibc-like ELF systems, distinct from kernel- or OS-name-specific builtin headers such as gnu.h or linux.h.
same_name_distinction: Within the gnu-user same-name pair, this header is the shared GNU userspace spec/configuration layer that defines startup, endfile, library, threading, sanitizer, and libc hook policy; gnu-user.opt only contributes the small shared driver option set used by that layer.
